newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U warns its forecasts were high-analysts.
newsitem.headline: P&U warns its forecasts were high-analysts.

text.p: Drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn has been telling analysts that profit forecasts for the second quarter of 1997 and full-year were high and that forecasts should be lowered, several analysts said on Friday.

Analysts told Reuters that in phone calls with analysts, P&U had emphasised that sales for its older products had been sluggish and that full year figures would reflect large restructuring costs which will continue to weigh down results.
They said the Swedish-U.S. drugs group said the markets' average forecasts had been high.
"Pharmacia told us last week that the average forecast for profits in the second quater were too high," said one analyst, who did not want to be named.
